recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，造血組織內有一個邊界清楚、顏色較淡粉紫的圓形結節，由類上皮組織球聚集而成，中央沒有壞死，周圍是正常三系造血與脂肪細胞，符合非壞死性肉芽腫（non-necrotizing granuloma）。
features: Well-circumscribed, pale-staining nodular aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes within hematopoietic marrow
No central caseous necrosis within the granuloma
Surrounding marrow mildly hypercellular with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and fat spaces
Extensive areas of hemorrhage/red cells in the specimen, likely biopsy-related
Low magnification limits evaluation of giant cells and organisms
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a mildly hypercellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and interspersed fat. A well-circumscribed, pale-staining nodular aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes is present without central necrosis; additional areas of hemorrhage are noted, likely procedural. Giant cells and organisms cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a non-necrotizing granuloma; in a patient with sarcoidosis this is supportive, but special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi and cultures are needed to exclude infection.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas often show caseous necrosis and AFB-positive organisms, and require microbiologic exclusion even when non-necrotizing.
Fungal granulomas may contain yeast forms demonstrable on GMS or PAS stains.
Lymphoid aggregates are composed of small dark lymphocytes rather than pale epithelioid histiocytes and are confirmed by CD20/CD3 immunostains.
Lipogranulomas are small histiocytic aggregates around fat vacuoles, commonly near sinusoids, without the compact epithelioid pattern.
